reference_format.note: YY/NNNNN with no type suffix. Not to be confused with the New Forest National Park Authority, a separate planning authority with its own portal.

quirks.summary: keyVal is not the usual uppercase alphanumeric token: it reads like '_NEWFO_DCAPR_226451', with a leading underscore and underscores inside.
quirks.detail: A keyVal grep of [A-Z0-9]+ matches nothing, so a search that returned results reads as having returned none.
quirks.workaround: Match keyVal=([^&"'\s]+), i.e. everything up to the next separator.

quirks.summary: No Modern.gov or other committee-system link was found from the council's 'Councillors and democracy' page; committee information there is in the council's own article pages.
quirks.workaround: Look up the planning committee's papers from the council's meeting calendar before recording a committee report as missing.

pacing.note: Five requests at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26 with no 429 or challenge.
